policy: Every migration or archive-ready repository must have an explicit cleanup record. Migration repositories remain non-canonical until every blocking lane is resolved. Archive-ready repositories remain non-deployable and should be archived rather than deleted.

Keep tools, education, certification, diagnostics and current production integration non-canonical here until an explicit cutover decision.
exitCriteria: Every overlapping route/domain is either cut over explicitly or removed as duplicate migration code.
All unique branch commits are merged, migrated, superseded or classified as historical-only.
No canonical domain ownership is claimed until a documented platform cutover.
No production route is owned directly while repository status is migration.

blockers: Classify all non-default branches with commits not present on main.
